extracted.intended_audience: Clinicians, researchers, and authors preparing clinical case reports for professional presentation or scientific publication
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing clinical case reports that are accurate and transparent by following the CARE checklist and related explanatory materials. Includes resources (checklist, translations, explanation document) and considerations about preprints and journal policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: CARE Checklist
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the CARE Checklist to increase the accuracy and transparency of case reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page provides the 2013 CARE Checklist in English and multiple translations (Chinese, Croatian, Dutch, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish). The checklist is the primary tool referenced for structuring case reports for professional presentation and scientific publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: CARE guidelines: consensus-based clinical case reporting guideline development (2013)
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow the consensus-based CARE guideline document (2013) that defines the checklist and its rationale.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This publication (BMJ Case Reports, 2013) establishes the CARE checklist and the consensus process; it should be consulted to understand the foundational standards behind the checklist items.

rubrics_metrics.name: CARE explanation and elaboration (2017)
rubrics_metrics.description: Consult the CARE explanation and elaboration document (2017) for detailed guidance on applying the checklist items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The 2017 document (Journal of Clinical Epidemiology abstract available) provides expanded explanations, examples, and rationale for each checklist item to improve reporting quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of case-report tools and templates referencing CARE
rubrics_metrics.description: Employ tools and templates that reference the CARE guidelines to improve report completeness and transparency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page notes that case report related tools and templates referencing CARE increase the accuracy and transparency of case reports; users are encouraged to adopt such templates when preparing reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consideration of preprints and journal policies
rubrics_metrics.description: Be aware of the relationship between preprints, preprint servers, and medical journals when preparing and submitting case reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An overview about preprints and medical journals is provided for information—authors should consult it to understand implications of posting preprints and journal submission policies relevant to case reports.
